purposeAndScope.intendedUse: Organize valuation evidence for an informed request that the insurer reconsider the vehicle valuation.
purposeAndScope.scopeStatement: This self-service evidence package summarizes the frozen insurer, customer, market, and deterministic calculation records identified below.

reviewedEvidence.label: Customer-confirmed intake facts
reviewedEvidence.description: Vehicle and claim context retained in the immutable source snapshot.

reviewedEvidence.label: Insurer valuation report extraction
reviewedEvidence.description: Normalized report facts and insurer comparables frozen with the source document digest.

reviewedEvidence.label: Deterministic analysis artifact
reviewedEvidence.description: The immutable analysis run, calculations, findings, and limitations.

reviewedEvidence.label: Independent market records
reviewedEvidence.description: Selected external advertised-price evidence retained by the analysis engine.

executiveConclusion.summary: The deterministic assessment identified a material undervaluation signal in the reviewed evidence. The stated range is a range of selected advertised prices, not a point actual-cash-value determination or guaranteed settlement amount.

insurerComparableReview.methodologyStatement: Every insurer comparable available in the frozen assessment is shown descriptively. V1 does not assign a professional retained, challenged, or excluded weight.

primary.description: Resolved listings active on the loss date form the primary external evidence set selected by Phase 3D.

secondary.label: Secondary current market evidence
secondary.description: Current evidence is retained as secondary context and is not combined with the primary loss-date historical price set.

adjustmentsAndCalculations.methodologyStatement: Only stored deterministic calculations are shown. No report-generation adjustment or professional weighting is added.

calculations.label: Primary evidence comparison
calculations.description: Deterministic comparison of the insurer valuation with the selected primary advertised-price median.

evidenceReconciliation.summary: The supported range follows directly from the minimum, median, and maximum advertised prices in the selected primary evidence set. No point actual-cash value or independent dollar adjustment was added.

preliminaryVersusFinal.summary: The final assessment confirms the preliminary result without a material change.

findings.label: Historical evidence is primary
findings.description: Resolved listings active on the loss date provide the primary external comparison.

findings.label: Current evidence is secondary
findings.description: Current inventory is secondary context and is not combined with the loss-date historical price set.

findings.label: External comparison set was bounded
findings.description: Lower-ranked eligible external records outside the policy comparison-set limit were excluded.

findings.label: External median is above the insurer valuation
findings.description: The selected external advertised-price median is above the insurer valuation or stated offer.

findings.label: Insurer valuation is below the external range
findings.description: The insurer valuation or stated offer is below the selected external advertised-price range.

findings.label: Material gap threshold was met
findings.description: The stored primary median gap meets the material screening threshold with strong loss-date historical evidence.

assumptions.label: No physical vehicle inspection
assumptions.description: Venfour did not physically inspect the subject vehicle for this evidence package.

limitations.label: Not an independent appraisal
limitations.description: This evidence comparison is not an independent vehicle appraisal.

limitations.label: Does not calculate a legal settlement
limitations.description: This analysis does not calculate a legally owed settlement amount.

limitations.label: Policy thresholds are not legal standards
limitations.description: Classification thresholds are screening-policy thresholds, not legal or industry standards.

limitations.label: Negotiation output is not included
limitations.description: Negotiation, demand, and action guidance are not included.

limitations.label: Advertised prices are not completed transactions
limitations.description: Advertised listing prices are not verified completed-sale prices.

limitations.label: No independent mileage adjustment
limitations.description: Mileage differences are reported without an independent dollar-per-mile adjustment.

limitations.label: No independent condition adjustment
limitations.description: No independently invented vehicle-condition adjustment is applied.

limitations.label: No independent options adjustment
limitations.description: No independently invented option, package, or equipment adjustment is applied.

limitations.label: Provider coverage is limited
limitations.description: Provider evidence may not capture every vehicle available in the relevant market.

limitations.label: Current listings are not loss-date evidence
limitations.description: Current inventory is current-market context and is not proof of loss-date conditions.

limitations.label: Historical evidence is date-level only
limitations.description: Historical activity is established at calendar-date level; the exact loss time within that day is unavailable.

limitations.label: External comparison set is bounded
limitations.description: External statistics use the bounded best-ranked eligible set selected without reference to price.

reviewContext.searchDescription: The recorded search used 2 search areas, with 100-mile radii around those search centers.
